column3: Bob Dylan wrote songs that appear on Johnny Cash\'s "Johnny Cash At San Quentin", U2\'s "Rattle And Hum", Peter, Paul & Mary\'s "The Best Of Peter, Paul And Mary: (Ten) Years Together", and Jimi Hendrix\'s "Experience Hendrix - The Best Of Jimi Hendrix". On "Rattle And Hum", he also sang backing vocals and played organ.
Nate Haessly recorded "Átta" by Sigur Rós and engineered "The Land Is Inhospitable And So Are We" by Mitski.
Laura Moody played cello on "Átta" by Sigur Rós and "Romance" by Fontaines D.C. Her contributions can be heard on both records.
Dan Wallin mixed Lerner & Loewe\'s "Camelot (Original Motion Picture Sound Track)" and engineered "Annie (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)".
Kevin Killen produced U2\'s "Rattle And Hum". He also engineered and mixed "Lazarus" by the Original New York Cast Of Lazarus, David Bowie And Enda Walsh.
Chris Galland mixed Lana Del Rey\'s "Born To Die" and engineered "Chris" by Christine And The Queens.

Tom Elmhirst mixed "Lazarus" by Original New York Cast Of Lazarus, David Bowie And Enda Walsh, and "The Rise & Fall Of A Midwest Princess" by Chappell Roan. His work appears on both records in the mixing role.
Eddie Kramer engineered "1" by The Beatles. He also engineered, produced, and remastered "Experience Hendrix - The Best Of Jimi Hendrix" by Jimi Hendrix.

Greg Kurstin produced and wrote a song on Kendrick Lamar\'s "Damn." On P!NK\'s "Trustfall," he produced, engineered, wrote a song, and played bass, drums, electric guitar, keyboards, percussion, and synthesizer.
Adam Clayton played bass guitar on U2\'s "Rattle And Hum", and he also wrote a song on Kendrick Lamar\'s "Damn.".
Larry Mullen played drums on U2\'s "Rattle And Hum". He also earned a songwriting credit on Kendrick Lamar\'s "Damn.".
Manny Marroquin mixed Lana Del Rey\'s "Born To Die" and Christine And The Queens\' "Chris". His work behind the boards helped shape both records.
Jerry Wexler produced Aretha Franklin\'s "2 Originals Of Aretha Franklin" and wrote a song on Carole King\'s "Tapestry".
Serban Ghenea mixed "Trustfall" by P!NK and "The Rise & Fall Of A Midwest Princess" by Chappell Roan. His work appears on both records.
Brian Eno played keyboards on U2\'s "Rattle And Hum". He also wrote a song on "Lazarus" by the Original New York Cast Of Lazarus, David Bowie And Enda Walsh.
Phil Spector wrote a song on Amy Winehouse\'s "At The BBC". He also produced The Beatles\' "1" and "Let It Be".
Eric Clapton played guitar on "The Beatles" by The Beatles and on "The Secret Policeman\'s Concert" by Various. His playing is the credit he carries on both records.
Richard Berry wrote a song on The Kinks\' "Sunny Afternoon" and a song on "Quadrophenia (Music From The Soundtrack Of The Who Film)". His writing connects these two classic records of the era.
Lennon-McCartney wrote songs on "The Beatles", "Abbey Road", "Rubber Soul", and "Magical Mystery Tour" by The Beatles, and on "Rattle And Hum" by U2. They also composed for "1" by The Beatles.
